question: Sarojini Naidu was elected first Indian woman President of the Indian National Congress at ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "__Kanpur__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarojini Naidu** was an Indian political activist, poet, and prominent leader in India's struggle for independence.
 
• She was the first Indian woman president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• She was a prolific poet. She wrote The Golden Threshold, The Bird of Time.
 
• She was also known as the **'Nightingale of India'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian National Congress** is a political party in India that was established in 1885.
 
• **Womesh Chandra Banerjee** was the first president of Congress.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru **dominated the congress party and won a number of elections.
